_about: Projects on the app's Today board (owner, 26 Nov 2026): work that is not a channel reel. The project's session updates its entry at every stage in the same push as the work (design/runbook-studio.md "Projects"). stage: planned | building | stills | render | checking | critic | done | waiting (on the owner) | failed. line: one plain sentence. pct: optional 0-100. history: newest last, at most 20. The Worker reads this file from main (GET /api/projects, about 2 min cache) and merges any newer `node scripts/stage.mjs project:<id> <stage>` line. A done project leaves the board 2 days after its last update.
